title: Describe the units changed
responsibility: Names distinct registered owners of changed files and counts files without owners.

inputs.name: changedUnits.paths
inputs.description: The repository paths reported as changed; each array entry is passed to owners in order and contributes independently to the outside-file count. Paths are not included in the notice, and repeated paths are counted repeatedly when they have no owners.

inputs.name: changedUnits.owners
inputs.description: The lookup called once for each path to return candidate unit ids. Valid unit ids are deduplicated and sorted for naming; an empty result counts the path as outside, while a nonempty result with no valid ids does not.

outputs.name: changedUnits
outputs.description: The notice for valid owner ids and/or paths whose lookup returns an empty array; valid ids are deduplicated, sorted and rendered as unit references, with at most 40 named and any remainder counted. Empty-owner paths are counted separately; no notice is returned when no valid id or empty-owner path exists, and paths themselves are never printed.
examples: Units changed: [[unit:desktop.function.changed-units]], [[unit:desktop.function.entity-references]]; 2 files outside any unit.
